feedback_flag.title: Feedback Flag
feedback_flag.no_flags: Choose Place flag, then right-click a block. Open this menu with /feedbackflag.
feedback_flag.memo_placeholder: Describe this flag's purpose or add a reminder…
feedback_flag.delete_hint: Existing timeline events are retained. Use Undo in the menu to restore the last deletion.
feedback_flag.observation_note: Received server block state. Only loaded blocks are observed. Inventories and other block entity data are not recorded.
feedback_flag.press_key: Press a key or mouse button…
feedback_flag.keys_hint: Both shortcuts start unassigned. /feedbackflag opens the menu. Press the placement key, then right-click a block.
feedback_flag.place_hint: Right-click a block to pin a flag. Press the placement key again or use /feedbackflag place to cancel.
feedback_flag.look_at_block: Look at a block within reach first.
feedback_flag.flag_limit: This world has reached the limit of 128 flags.
feedback_flag.load_failed: History could not be loaded. Original file preserved; saving is disabled.
feedback_flag.save_failed: Could not save history. Retrying automatically.
feedback_flag.legacy_event_tick: %s ticks since the first legacy change (old clock)
feedback_flag.mixed_ticks: Receipt order · see each record for its tick
feedback_flag.clear_history_hint: Deletes these records and resets activity counts. Flags, tags, memos and settings stay. After a full reset, the next change is the new zero tick. This cannot be undone.
feedback_flag.display_hint: Click to cycle Flags → Block outlines → Both. Outlines mark the watched one-block coordinates. When flags are hidden, use the menu or crouch and right-click the block with an empty hand to edit.
feedback_flag.tags_hint: Up to 8 tags, 24 characters each. Example: input, circuit A. Stored separately from name and memo; filter the timeline by tag.
feedback_flag.group_hint: Click to expand or collapse changes in this tick. Each color represents one flag.
feedback_flag.individual_hint: Enable or pause all recording for this flag. Changes made while paused are not recorded later.
feedback_flag.watch_blocks_hint: Record block type changes, such as stone → air (removal) or air → block (placement).
feedback_flag.watch_states_hint: Record property changes within the same block, such as lever power, open doors, or crop age.
feedback_flag.clear_filter_hint: Resets all history or this selected flag, regardless of the tag filter.
feedback_flag.remove_all_title: Remove all %s flags in this world?
feedback_flag.remove_all_hint: Removes flags and memos in every dimension. Existing history, final tags and actual blocks stay intact. Use Undo in the menu to restore this deletion once.
feedback_flag.visual.hint: Applies to all markers in this world when you Save.
feedback_flag.visual.outline_hint: Base line width from 1 to 8. A recent change briefly uses 1.5 times this width.
feedback_flag.visual.scale_hint: Flag size from 25% to 300%. The name and click area scale with the flag.
feedback_flag.visual.position_hint: Moves only the flag from its default position above the block. Units are blocks: +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Watched coordinates and outlines stay in place.
feedback_flag.visual.through_walls_hint: When enabled, watched block outlines remain visible behind other blocks.
feedback_flag.search_tags_hint_detail: Separate tags with commas to match every entered tag.
feedback_flag.search_active_hint: Matches the flag's own recording switch, independently of global recording and chunk loading.
feedback_flag.undo.ready: Restore the %s flags from the last deletion, including names, colors, tags, memos and settings. One deletion can be undone.
feedback_flag.undo.conflict: A new flag occupies a restore position. Undo cannot overwrite it.
feedback_flag.undo.limit: Restoring would exceed the 128-flag limit. The deletion is still retained.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.feedback_flag: Watch block changes with flags and a relative-tick timeline.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.feedback_:
Pin personal flags to blocks and record changes to block types and states. Includes flags and block outlines, names, colors, tags, memos, search, undo for the last deletion, and a timeline starting at tick 0 for the first change.

Open with /feedbackflag or /ff. Menu and placement shortcuts are unbound by default. Client-only: no server installation required; records only block updates received by your client.
feedback_flag.bulk.title: Edit selected flags
feedback_flag.bulk.hint: %s selected · Choose fields to change. Names and memos stay intact.
feedback_flag.bulk.tags_hint: Add preserves existing tags. Remove matches whole tags. Replace all with an empty field clears tags.
feedback_flag.bulk.invalid: Check color/tags. Each flag may have at most 8 resulting tags.
feedback_flag.timeline.title: Timeline explorer
feedback_flag.timeline.empty: No events in this interval. Pan or choose Fit all.
feedback_flag.archive.scope: Saves all records in the current flag/tag filters and zoom interval, across all list pages.
feedback_flag.archive.name: Archive name (up to 64 characters)
feedback_flag.archive.save_hint: Saves JSON for in-game viewing and HTML for your browser.
feedback_flag.archive.capture_count: %s events in the selected interval · Captured when this screen opened
feedback_flag.archive.save_failed: Could not save. Check folder access and free space, then retry.
feedback_flag.archive.load_failed: Could not read records. Check the files and refresh.
feedback_flag.archive.library_hint: Select an archive to open a read-only timeline.
feedback_flag.archive.invalid: This archive is invalid or unsupported. The original file is unchanged.
